source.pageNumbering: Reader id 1..10 = physical PDF 2..11. printedPage 0,1 are inferred sequence positions, NOT visible labels; printedLabel null there. Visible printed labels 2..9 on physical 4..11.
source.verification: All ten rendered pages visually checked; all 76 verse-end CID markers independently enumerated. PDF cover excluded; catchwords outside frame excluded.

markerRule: Extracted fallback codepoint minus 769 gives verse number for CID markers 770..1055; validated on the rendered selected pages only. Fatiha PDF content order is 1,2,4,3,5,6,7; sorted marker set verified, not used to reconstruct Arabic.
